Name: Kupa Pixel Portrait
Author: kupado
Description:
[b]Install[/b]

1.Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?]Portraiture[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url].
2.Unzip this mod and place it. (~\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[u][b]Kupa Pixel Portrait[/b][/u])
3.﻿After the game starts, press the P key while talking with someone.P key may need to be pressed several times.

[b]Known Issues[/b]

1.It cannot be changed during the conversation in the OP. Wait until the game starts.
2.Portrait of some vender is not changed.As a passive measure, the vender portrait can be hidden in the in-game options.
